marta: Quick question after the all-hands 1: you mentioned reallocating headcount into product teams for Q4. How does that work if a team already has approved reqs?
owen: We9;re not retroactively moving approved reqs. Reallocation applies to unfilled, unapproved pipeline roles only. If req has an offer in flight, it stays with the originating team.
marta: Got it. Is there a central priority rubric we should follow when requesting extra headcount?
maya: Yes 1: impact on revenue/SLAs, time-to-value, customer-critical, and reduce cross-team toil. Attach a 1-pager with metrics. Use the new prioritization scorecard (link in the all-hands doc).
kevin: Who signs off on reassigning a posted req from one squad to another?
people-ops-bot: Heads up 1: Authorization flow: TL -> Dir -> People Ops -> Finance. For urgent customer impact, SLT can fast-track. Use `/req-alloc fasttrack` in Hiring Hub.
sara: Any change to interview loops or bar for infra/platform hires? Heard we9;re tightening senior IC interviews.
maya: We're standardizing loops: 1 system design + 1 coding + 1 behavioral for senior platform ICs. We9;re emphasizing ops reliability experience and large-scale system tradeoffs.
marta: What about internal transfers? If my SRE wants to move into Dedicated team, do they need a new req?
owen: Internal transfers still need req approvals for planning, but we try to make transfers quick. No external posting required in many cases. People Ops will flag role as internal-transfer preferred.
kevin: Any freeze on new grad or junior IC hires?
maya: Slight slowdown for junior headcount as we prioritise senior hires this cycle. Not a freeze, but fewer slots. Intern program will be 10-12 interns, more product-facing.
sara: Are we changing ownership between eng-runtime and eng-runtime-tools? There9;s confusion about where the build cache infra lives.
maya: We9;re consolidating the build/cache ownership under eng-platform. Runtime will keep model execution optimizations. This reduces the number of cross-team handoffs.
marta: Timeline to see updated org map?
people-ops-bot: Reminder 1: Org map + role matrix will be posted to the all-hands page by EOD Friday. Subscribe to updates in the doc to get a ping.
kevin: For manager hiring, are we prioritising external hires or promoting from within?
maya: Both. We9;re doing a small number of external senior manager searches (2-3) and will promote for team-level managers where there are strong IC candidates.
omen: How should leads escalate when they think a req should be rescoped (e.g., Jr SWE -> Sr SWE)?
people-ops-bot: Use `/req-edit` with justification + impact. Include cost delta and ramp assumptions. Approval chain same as reallocation.
marta: Thanks everyone : this helps clarify.
kevin: thanks :thumbsup:
